name: kong-cost-race
description: Test 3 on Kong OSS 3.9.3, run through run-cost.sh with a throwaway consumer (its limit in the run's meta.json note). 3 requests a minute, policy local, and ten requests at once. Kong checks the count when a request arrives but adds to it in a timer afterwards (rate-limiting/handler.lua: timer_at(0, increment)), so a burst may get past the limit; the run shows how many of the ten are admitted. Then a second burst in the same minute, expected refused.
